title: Existence of Cech comparison data
statement: For any scheme X, family U of opens with supremum top, and arbitrary module sheaves F,G [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], there exists a computing sectionwise resolution pairing D together with CupCechResolutionComparison U data [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data] for its left, right and target resolutions. Each comparison has the specified restriction alpha and augmentation beta components, alpha a quasi-isomorphism, and an isomorphism from module cohomology to total homology identifying both global resolution classes and every canonical Cech comparison [def-sc-module-cech-comparison]. No quasi-coherence or degree hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use moduleCup_godement_pairing to obtain the integer flasque complexes and tensor chain map. The private supportedNat, restrictionQuasiIso and natAugmentation helpers restrict the augmentations to natural degrees. computingFlasqueResolution extends each augmentation to an injective comparison and uses moduleCup_flasque_acyclicity and the acyclic-resolution comparison criterion to prove computes. tensorChainSectionPair and the tensor differential identity prove restriction, signed Leibniz and augmentation pairing. Assemble D and retain all three flasqueness proofs in a local existential. These helpers reuse the proof of ModuleCupPairingExists without modifying that module or discarding its flasque hypotheses.

Apply cupCechFlasqueResolutionComparison separately to D.left, D.right and D.target using the three retained termwise flasqueness proofs. Combine the three Nonempty conclusions with D. No arbitrary data are chosen from a sorried existence theorem to define a public object.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cupCechResolutionComparison (X : Scheme.{v}) {ι : Type v}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ D : CupResolutionPairing F G,
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.left) ∧
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.right) ∧
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.target)
